excel.zh: 而且，与现代没有什么不同，不同的大学在不同的学科上表现卓越。

excel.en: But in this episode, we'll be hearing how dyslexics have other skills which allow them to excel in the workplace.
excel.zh: 但在本期节目中，我们将听到读写障碍者如何拥有其他技能，使他们能够在职场中脱颖而出。

excel.en: She eventually got to medical school, where she excelled.
excel.zh: 她最终进入了医学院，并在那里表现优异。

excel.en: As a primary school student, Ramanujan excelled.
excel.zh: 作为一名小学生，Ramanujan非常优秀。

excel.en: These were industries that Britain had excelled in in the 19th century and had been able to sell its products around the world.
excel.zh: 这些都是英国在19世纪傲视全球并能将产品畅销世界各地的支柱产业。

exaggerate.en: But she was exaggerating. Her day wasn't really terrible – more like strange or annoying.
exaggerate.zh: 但她是在夸张。她的一天并不是真的那么糟糕——更像是有点奇怪或烦人。

exaggerate.en: But the critics weren’t having it. They argued that DOGE’s savings were wildly exaggerated.
exaggerate.zh: 但批评人士并不买账。他们认为 DOGE 节省的资金被严重夸大了。

exaggerate.en: Many of which were either exaggerated or simply untrue.
exaggerate.zh: 其中许多主张要么被夸大，要么纯属虚构。

exaggerate.en: Some believed he exaggerated his exploits for fame, but many saw him as the real deal—a man born to explore.
exaggerate.zh: 有些人认为他为了出名而夸大了自己的战绩，但许多人视他为货真价实的传奇——一个天生为探索而生的人。

exaggerate.en: The finding was not exaggerated. But this was most probably a consequence of the treatments he received, rather than a cause of his illness.
exaggerate.zh: 这一发现并未夸大。但这很可能是他接受治疗的结果，而不是他生病的原因。

extraordinary.en: The DRC’s extraordinary mineral wealth, has made its problems far more difficult to solve.
extraordinary.zh: 刚果（金）非凡的矿产财富使其问题变得更加难以解决。

extraordinary.en: No Polish state. This is one of the most fascinating, extraordinary parts of Polish history.
extraordinary.zh: 没有波兰国。这是波兰历史上最迷人、最非凡的部分之一。

extraordinary.en: It was an extraordinary move. Overnight, books, newspapers, and street signs had to be rewritten.
extraordinary.zh: 这是一个非凡的举措。一夜之间，书籍、报纸和路标都必须重新编写。

extraordinary.en: Through countless experiments, often with limited funding and basic equipment, the Curies made extraordinary discoveries.
extraordinary.zh: 通过无数次的实验，通常是在资金有限和设备简陋的情况下，居里夫妇做出了非凡的发现。

extraordinary.en: On the night of November 4th, 2017, something extraordinary happened in Riyadh.
extraordinary.zh: 2017年11月4日晚，利雅得发生了一件非同寻常的事。

extinction.en: A second argument is that zoos protect endangered species from extinction through breeding.
extinction.zh: 第二个论点是，动物园通过繁育来保护濒危物种免于灭绝。

extinction.en: And now they are gone from the ecosystem because of extinction, domestication.
extinction.zh: 而如今，由于灭绝和驯化，它们已经从生态系统中消失了。

extinction.en: For some, zoos are a good way to teach people about nature and save endangered species from extinction.
extinction.zh: 对某些人来说，动物园是向人们普及自然知识以及从灭绝边缘拯救濒危物种的好方法。

extinction.en: Extinction is when an animal species no longer exists.
extinction.zh: extinction(灭绝)是指某个动物物种不复存在。

extinction.en: Although Japan, Iceland and Norway continue to hunt whales, there's no doubt the ban has saved many whales species from extinction.
extinction.zh: 尽管日本、冰岛和挪威仍在继续捕鲸，但毫无疑问，这项禁令已经让许多鲸鱼物种免于灭绝。

explode.en: When it exploded, injuring a security officer, his 17-year campaign of violence had begun.
explode.zh: 当它爆炸并炸伤一名保安时，他长达 17 年的暴力行动开始了。

explode.en: From the 1840s onwards, the British railway network exploded.
explode.zh: 从 1840 年代开始，英国铁路网迅猛发展。

explode.en: The city’s population exploded from around 1 million people in the 1940s to more than 10 million by the 1980s.
explode.zh: 城市人口从1940年代的大约100万人激增到1980年代的1000多万人。

explode.en: The whale couldn't stand a chance. In 1870, a chap – that's an informal word for a man – called Svend Foyn invented the exploding harpoon, a weapon for killing whales.
explode.zh: 鲸鱼从此毫无胜算(couldn't stand a chance)。1870 年，一个叫 Svend Foyn 的家伙(chap，这是对'男人'的非正式说法)发明了爆炸鱼叉——一种用来捕杀鲸鱼的武器。

explode.en: The idea was to creep up, undetected, on British ships and plant a bomb on the ship’s hull, the side of the ship, and then rush away before the bomb exploded.
explode.zh: 这个想法是悄悄地、不被察觉地靠近英国船只，在船体即船的侧面安放一枚炸弹，然后在炸弹爆炸前迅速逃离。

exclaim.en: When Nish says this, James exclaims, " We're doomed!" – an informal way of saying we're destined to fail.
exclaim.zh: 当Nish这么说时，James惊呼道：“We're doomed!”（我们完了！）——这是一种非正式的说法，意指我们注定要失败。

explanation.en: They’re difficult to understand. So people turn to explanations that feel easier and satisfying.
explanation.zh: 它们很难理解。因此，人们转向那些感觉更简单、更能带来满足感的解释。

explanation.en: “Yes, I finished a report.” Open questions, on the other hand, invite explanation.
explanation.zh: “是的，我写完报告了。”另一方面，开放式问题则能引发进一步的解释。

explanation.en: Humans naturally prefer simple explanation and ideas that agree with what we already believe.
explanation.zh: 人类天生更喜欢简单的解释以及符合我们既有信念的观点。

explanation.en: You can Google almost anything, or AI can generate explanations in seconds.
explanation.zh: 你几乎可以谷歌搜索任何东西，或者让AI在几秒钟内生成解释。

explanation.en: A myth is usually a traditional story involving gods or supernatural explanations of the world.
explanation.zh: 神话通常是涉及神灵或对世界做出超自然解释的传统故事。

excessively.en: Overdependence happens when you rely on something excessively for your survival or success.
excessively.zh: 过度依赖发生在当你过度依赖某事物来求得生存或成功时。

excessively.en: But not everyone likes the song. Some call it saccharine – an adjective meaning excessively sweet, sentimental or insincere.
excessively.zh: 但并不是所有人都喜欢这首歌。有些人称之为“saccharine”（甜腻的）——一个形容词，意为过于甜美、多愁善感或虚情假意。

excessively.en: Glaze is to excessively or undeservedly praise someone.
excessively.zh: Glaze 指的是过度地、名不副实地吹捧某人。

excessively.en: Yeah. Well, I mean, Russ, I won't exaggerate things or seem to pander excessively by saying that I wrote this book just with the intent of appearing on EconTalk.
excessively.zh: 是啊。呃，我是说，罗斯，我不想夸大其词，也不想显得过度讨好——但要说我写这本书就是为了能上EconTalk，那倒也不至于。

extinct.en: The first settlers would’ve seen enormous creatures that are now extinct, known as megafauna.
extinct.zh: 最早的定居者会看到如今已经灭绝的庞大生物，也就是所谓的巨型动物群。

extinct.en: Why? Why would extinct animals look like larger versions of living ones?
extinct.zh: 为什么呢？为什么灭绝的动物会长得像现存动物的放大版？

extinct.en: The dinosaurs and the wild aurochs are two examples of extinct animals.
extinct.zh: 恐龙和野生原牛就是两个已灭绝动物的例子。

extinct.en: In the UK, we have 26 bumblebee species but three have gone extinct.
extinct.zh: 在英国，我们有26种大黄蜂，但其中3种已经灭绝。

extinct.en: In South America, Darwin found or was shown fossils from large extinct animals, such as giant armadillo-like creatures.
extinct.zh: 在南美洲，Darwin发现了或者有人向他展示了大型灭绝动物的化石，例如类似巨型犰狳的生物。

existence.en: For most of its modern existence, Italy was a country of emigration, not immigration.
existence.zh: 在其现代存在的大部分时间里，意大利是一个人口流出国，而不是移民流入国。

existence.en: That means humans lived without written language for the vast majority of our existence.
existence.zh: 这意味着人类在绝大多数生存时期里都没有书面语言。

existence.en: If an animal species is clinging on, it's holding on to existence with great effort.
existence.zh: 如果某种动物物种正在苦苦支撑（clinging on），它就是在付出巨大努力维持生存。

existence.en: Now, the existence of coal had been common knowledge for centuries.
existence.zh: 其实，煤炭的存在几个世纪以来一直是常识。

existence.en: And that's an unpleasant existence. But again, this goes back to the equivalent of the marshmallow test.
existence.zh: 那将是一种令人痛苦的生存状态。但话说回来，这可以追溯到棉花糖测试的等价物。

exhaust.en: He is left in it, thrashing and shouting, until he exhausts himself and goes quiet.
exhaust.zh: 他被留在束衣里，挣扎着、大喊大叫，直到筋疲力尽、安静下来。

exhaust.en: So, if you feel drained or exhausted at home, it could be your clutter.
exhaust.zh: 所以，如果你在家感到筋疲力尽，那可能是因为你的杂物。

exhaust.en: After an hour or two of this, decluttering becomes physically and emotionally exhausting.
exhaust.zh: 经过一两个小时的这样折腾，断舍离就会变得让人身心俱疲。

exhaust.en: It was used simply because it was exhausting and unpleasant.
exhaust.zh: 使用它纯粹是因为它令人精疲力竭且极不愉快。

exhaust.en: And to a population exhausted by years of instability and civil war, the idea of a strongman didn’t sound so bad.
exhaust.zh: 对于被多年的动荡和内战搞得身心俱疲的人民来说，“强人”的概念听起来似乎并不是那么坏。

exotic.en: In the 1920s, noodles were popular because they were exotic, meaning foreign, unusual and exciting.
exotic.zh: 在20世纪20年代，面条很受欢迎，因为它们很“异国情调”，意思是来自外国、不同寻常且令人兴奋。

exotic.en: The adjective exotic means unusual and exciting because of coming from far away.
exotic.zh: 形容词 exotic（异国情调的）意指由于来自远方而不同寻常且令人兴奋。

exotic.en: He had a knack for languages and a taste for the exotic.
exotic.zh: 他很有语言天赋，并且对异国风情充满兴趣。

exotic.en: What the results suggested, he said, was that obedience is far more common than we assume, and the conditions which produce it are neither rare nor exotic.
exotic.zh: 他说，这些结果所揭示的，是服从的现象远比我们以为的更普遍，而催生这种服从的条件，既不罕见，也不特殊。

exotic.en: No matter how lax lending standards got, no matter how many exotic mortgage products were created to shoehorn people into homes they couldn't possibly afford, no matter what the mortgage machine tried, the people just couldn't swing it.
exotic.zh: 无论放贷标准变得多么宽松，无论创造出多少奇奇怪怪的房贷产品去硬塞给那些根本买不起房的人，无论按揭机器怎么努力，老百姓就是搞不定。

exploit.en: To make matters worse, powerful officials exploited this confusion for their own benefit.
exploit.zh: 更糟糕的是，有权有势的官员为了自身利益利用这种混乱。

exploit.en: Without a fair minimum wage, the most vulnerable in society risk being even more exploited by powerful corporations.
exploit.zh: 如果没有合理的最低工资，社会中最弱势的群体就有可能受到强大公司更严重的剥削。

exploit.en: Norway banned it altogether, which Swedish cinema posters exploited cheerfully, writing "So funny it was banned in Norway."
exploit.zh: 挪威则彻底禁播了它，瑞典的电影海报愉快地利用了这一点，上面写着“滑稽至极，以至于在挪威被禁”。

exploit.en: Scipio outmanoeuvred him, used Roman discipline to resist the initial elephant charge, and then exploited gaps in the Carthaginian line.
exploit.zh: 西庇阿技高一筹，利用罗马军队的纪律抵挡住了最初的战象冲锋，随后成功切入了迦太基阵型的漏洞。

exploit.en: And stories of his exploits spread quickly.
exploit.zh: 他英勇事迹的故事迅速流传开来。

exceptional.en: Dogs bred for hunting, with speed, stamina, and an exceptional sense of smell.
exceptional.zh: 为狩猎而培育的狗，具备速度、耐力和非凡的嗅觉。

exceptional.en: We can all be inspired by stories of people who have exceptional determination.
exceptional.zh: 我们都可以从这些拥有非凡决心的人的故事中获得激励。

exceptional.en: The phrase out of the ordinary means unusual, uncommon, or exceptional.
exceptional.zh: 短语“out of the ordinary”意思是不同寻常的、罕见的或例外的。

exceptional.en: These were the Normans. These Normans were exceptional soldiers.
exceptional.zh: 他们就是诺曼人（Normans）。这些诺曼人是极其出色的士兵。

exceptional.en: It could be the Mother Teresa. These exceptional people who, without whom, nothing that we see would have occurred.
exceptional.zh: 也可以是特蕾莎修女。正是这些非凡的人物，如果没有他们，我们今天所看到的一切都不会发生。

examination.en: To diagnose means to identify a disease or health problem through medical examination.
examination.zh: 诊断的意思是通过医学检查来确定疾病或健康问题。

examination.en: As education expanded around the world, but particularly in Europe, written examinations became more common in schools.
examination.zh: 随着教育在世界范围内普及，特别是在欧洲，书面考试在学校中变得越来越普遍。

examination.en: More than 1,000 years ago, the Chinese Imperial Government was using civil service examinations to select officials, government officials.
examination.zh: 1000多年前，中国古代封建朝廷就曾使用科举考试来选拔官员、政府官员。

examination.en: I bring transparency to the conversation, and own it, and say that I'm going to be asking you some quite personal questions, and there may be also intimate examination… I want to assure you that this is confidential, that this is a safe, non-judgmental space…
examination.zh: 我在谈话中会保持透明，主动承担，并告诉对方我接下来要问一些相当私人的问题，可能还会有一些比较私密的检查……我想向你保证这是保密的，这是一个安全、不带评判的空间……

examine.en: Darwin loved collecting insects, examining rocks, and learning about the natural world.
examine.zh: Darwin热爱收集昆虫、检查岩石以及了解自然界。

examine.en: These tests are designed to examine how well you have learned something.
examine.zh: 这些测试旨在检验你对某事物的学习效果。

examine.en: To diagnose a disease or medical condition means to identify it by recognising the symptoms and examining the patient.
examine.zh: Diagnose（诊断）一种疾病或健康状况，意味着通过识别症状和检查患者来确定病情。

examine.en: Their meta-analysis examining video conferencing for second language learning found positive effects, including improvements in listening and speaking.
examine.zh: 他们的元分析考察了用于第二语言学习的视频会议，发现了积极的效果，包括听力和口语的提高。

examine.en: But when a local doctor examined them and found no clear cause, he gave an altogether different explanation: witchcraft.
examine.zh: 但当当地医生为她们检查却找不到明确病因时，他给出了一个完全不同的解释：巫术。

extent.en: Which reminds me of my question, Beth – what proportion of 11 to 30 year-olds get acne to some extent?
extent.zh: 这让我想起了我的问题，Beth——11到30岁的人群中，有多少比例在某种程度上长痤疮？

extent.en: Correct. And so to the extent that we're relative creatures, there are more losers than winners.
extent.zh: 没错。就我们是相对主义生物而言，输家确实比赢家多。

extent.en: It’s something that didn’t happen to France or Italy or Spain, at least not to the same extent.
extent.zh: 这种情况在法国、意大利或西班牙并没有发生，至少没有达到同样的程度。

extent.en: And to some extent, that's true, but mostly it's not true.
extent.zh: 在某种程度上，这或许是真的，但大部分情况下并非如此。

extent.en: But, talk about why that is and, to the extent it is answerable, who is responsible for it.
extent.zh: 但请谈谈为什么难以回答，以及在多大程度上能够回答——究竟是谁的功劳。

expand.en: It is a city built on water. That was conquered, rebuilt, expanded, and modernized.
expand.zh: 这是一座建立在水上的城市。它曾被征服、重建、扩建并现代化。

expand.en: This massive population increase meant the city expanded in size, spreading into nearby areas.
expand.zh: 这种巨大的人口增长意味着城市规模扩大了，蔓延到了附近的地区。

expand.en: And while AI is expanding quickly, some models are very expensive to train and run.
expand.zh: 虽然AI正在迅速扩张，但某些模型的训练和运行成本非常高昂。

expand.en: Cities grew and economies expanded, and over the centuries, many different dynasties rose and fell.
expand.zh: 城市不断发展，经济不断扩张，在过去的几个世纪里，许多不同的朝代兴衰更替。

expand.en: As the port expanded, new commercial districts were built around the port.
expand.zh: 随着港口的扩大，港口周围建起了新的商业区。

exit.en: It had underground tunnels, entrances and exits, and systems to control crowds.
exit.zh: 它拥有地下通道、出入口以及控制人群的系统。

exit.en: And this was just after Iqbal--just as Iqbal was exiting Grameenphone.
exit.zh: 那正是在伊克巴尔——就在伊克巴尔即将退出Grameenphone的时候。

exit.en: By this point, von Stauffenberg was making a beeline for the perimeter, heading for the exit as quickly as possible.
exit.zh: 此时此刻，冯·施陶芬贝格正直奔警戒线，以最快速度赶往出口。

exit.en: And then we find out that the bullet entered the back of her skull, went through her head, and then exited.
exit.zh: 然后我们发现子弹进入了她头骨的后部，穿过了她的头，然后出来了。

exit.en: So it like cut off a little piece of her nose, but the exit wound wasn't as bad as it could have been.
exit.zh: 所以它切掉了她鼻子的一小部分，但出口伤口并没有那么严重。

extend.en: It had never been extended to cover Islam, or Judaism, or any other faith.
extend.zh: 它从未扩大到涵盖伊斯兰教、犹太教或任何其他信仰。

extend.en: You don’t need to extend your visa. You can usually work without restrictions.
extend.zh: 你不需要延长签证。你通常可以不受限制地工作。

extend.en: Marie Skłodowska Curie’s influence extended far beyond her research.
extend.zh: Marie Skłodowska Curie 的影响远远超出了她的研究范畴。

extend.en: Should blasphemy law be extended to cover all religions?
extend.zh: 是否应该扩大亵渎法的范围以涵盖所有宗教？

extend.en: An Exclusive Economic Zone is an area of ocean which extends up to 200 nautical miles from a country’s coast.
extend.zh: 专属经济区是指从一国海岸线延伸达200海里的海洋区域。

execute.en: He delighted in seeing people squirm. Prisoners were executed in front of him for sport.
execute.zh: 他以看着别人痛苦挣扎为乐。囚犯们为了供他消遣而在他面前被处决。

execute.en: The Brotherhood was outlawed again, its leaders jailed or executed, but Sisi didn’t stop there.
execute.zh: 兄弟会再次被取缔，其领导人被捕或被处决，但 Sisi 并没有就此停手。

execute.en: And then you'll have a specific experience that helps you remember it and actually execute on it.
execute.zh: 然后你就会有一次具体的经历，帮助你记住它并真正去执行它。

execute.en: If the revolution failed, they were going to be sent to prison or, more likely, executed, killed.
execute.zh: 如果革命失败，他们将被送进监狱，或者更有可能被处决、杀死。

execute.en: Gladiators fought to the death, and prisoners were executed in public.
execute.zh: 角斗士为荣誉和生命而战，罪犯则被公开处决。

extravagant.en: Some even had perfume fountains at their extravagant banquets, spraying scented mist over their guests.
extravagant.zh: 有些人甚至在他们奢侈的宴会上设置了香水喷泉，向客人们喷洒带香味的雾气。

extravagant.en: He was also unlike most other kings. While many European monarchs were flamboyant, extravagant, obsessed with courts and ceremony and mistresses, George was frugal and hardworking.
extravagant.zh: 他也跟大多数其他国王不同。许多欧洲君主生活奢靡、铺张浪费，痴迷于宫廷礼仪和情妇，而 George 则节俭且勤奋。

exhibit.en: The first time I visited the British Museum in London as a child, my favorite exhibit was the Moai.
exhibit.zh: 我小时候第一次去伦敦的大英博物馆时，我最喜欢的展品就是这尊 Moai。

exhibit.en: There were many institutions in England where the mentally ill were treated far, far worse: chained to walls, exhibited to the public, or simply left to rot in their own filth.
exhibit.zh: 当时英格兰有许多机构，精神病患者在那里受到的待遇要糟糕得多：用铁链锁在墙上、向公众展示，或者任由他们在自己的污秽中腐烂。

extract.en: They have massive reserves of oil, but they’re not particularly efficient at extracting that oil.
extract.zh: 他们拥有庞大的石油储备，但在开采这些石油方面并不是特别高效。
